comment: Per-component bundle size budgets for @helixui/library (gzipped bytes). 3.2.0 raised standard 5120→5632 and complex 6144→6656 to absorb the WCAG 2.1 AA hover/active foreground-pinning CSS introduced by the palette refresh; healthcare a11y compliance is the load-bearing constraint, +0.5 KB the documented tradeoff. Changes require code review.

hx-button.reason: 3.2.1 added explicit :active rules for primary/danger filled variants (action.{primary,danger}.bg-active + text.on-{role}-strong + filter:none) to close a high-severity AA gap caught by Codex round-6 review where filter:brightness(0.8) produced sub-AA pressed-state contrast (primary 3.70:1, danger 3.26:1). Round-7 added the inverted-mode sister rules (action.{primary,danger}.bg-inverted-hover for inverted hover/pressed) closing the symmetric dark-surface UI-floor regression. Standard-mode pressed contrasts are now 7.03:1 / 7.96:1; inverted-mode hover/pressed are 7.27:1 / 6.27:1. Measured artifact growth ~0.14 KB; budget bumped one gating step from 5.5 KB to 6.0 KB to absorb this commit and any further AA pin growth in 3.2.x. Healthcare a11y compliance is the load-bearing constraint.

hx-color-picker.reason: Full color math library (HSV/RGB/HSL conversions), pointer-drag, 4 output formats. JS-only baseline: ~4057 gz.

hx-combobox.reason: Full ARIA combobox, multiple selection with chips, keyboard nav, filtering with debounce, ElementInternals form association. JS-only: ~4083 gz.

hx-date-picker.reason: Calendar grid rendering, full keyboard nav, focus trap, date utilities, ElementInternals form association. JS-only: ~4324 gz.

hx-file-upload.reason: Drag-and-drop file management with progress tracking, mixinDelegatesAria ARIA delegation, focus restoration after file removal, forced-colors support, and WCAG 2.5.5 touch targets. Baseline: ~4.64 KB gz; mandatory a11y fixes add ~1.1 KB; 3.2.0 AA hover/active pins add ~0.4 KB.

hx-number-input.reason: Stepper input with increment/decrement buttons, min/max/step validation, keyboard-repeating long-press, ElementInternals form association, forced-colors support. Baseline: ~5.2 KB gz.

hx-select.reason: ARIA listbox, keyboard nav, multiple selection, ElementInternals form association, floating-ui positioning. JS-only: ~5.18 KB gz; 3.2.0 AA hover/active pins add ~0.4 KB.

hx-side-nav.reason: Multi-level navigation with expand/collapse state management, keyboard nav, ARIA tree semantics, active-item tracking, and mobile-responsive behavior. Baseline: ~5.01 KB gz.

hx-slider.reason: Range input with value display, dual-handle range mode, ARIA slider semantics, keyboard nav, forced-colors support. Baseline: ~5.04 KB gz.

hx-time-picker.reason: Time parsing/validation, meridiem toggle, keyboard nav, ElementInternals form association. JS-only: ~5.01 KB gz; 3.2.0 AA hover/active pins add ~0.4 KB.
